referenzen.name: NIDO55
referenzen.claim: Partner looks, kids' and adult fashion & accessories.
referenzen.text: Nido55 is the creative nest of two friends and mums: their own motifs on partner looks, kids' and adult fashion, city shirts and accessories. Nido means nest in Spanish, the 55 stands for Mainz.
fakten: Partner looks, baby, kids' and adult fashion, bags
referenzen.suba: Our production network, workshops on products and decoration, production

personal_brand_schritte: We listen, sharpen your idea and work out together what your brand should stand for.
Logo, motifs, colours: our designers bring your ideas to life or prepare your drafts for print.
Depending on the project, you receive a technical drawing, a photo of the sample or a physical sample, and you approve it.
Decoration in our own production or full custom with our partners, from small quantities.
Your own labels, hangtags and packaging turn a shirt into your brand.
The finished goods come to you. If a product sells well, we reproduce quickly.

intro.text: Your guests and customers don't experience your brand only through the logo. They feel it in the shirt at reception, in the towel in the room and in the cup at breakfast. We equip hotels, restaurants and companies with everything they wear, touch and use. All from a single source, with one contact person.

sortiment.text: Polo shirts, shirts, jackets, aprons and uniforms for reception, service, kitchen and team. With embroidery or print.
Towels, bath towels and cushions with your logo, woven, embroidered or printed. For rooms, spa and pool.
From the decorated standard mug and special productions from Portugal to handmade tableware from Colombia.
Pavement signs, menus, table numbers, cutlery boxes and wooden serving boards with your logo. On request.

keramik_wege.text: Existing mugs and cups, decorated with engraving, print or sublimation. The quick and affordable solution, even for small quantities.
Mugs and tableware to your specifications, made by our partner in Portugal. Your own shape, colour and glaze, consistent across the series.
Every piece is hand-thrown and hand-painted in a ceramics studio in Bogotá. For hotels and restaurants that want to put something special on their guests' table.

manufaktur.text: Our partner studio in Bogotá combines traditional craftsmanship with modern design. Plates, cups, bowls and vases are made from natural materials, hand-thrown and hand-painted. This makes every piece part of your story. When a guest holds handmade tableware, it stays in their memory.

manufaktur.hinweis: Every glaze reacts a little differently in the kiln. Green tones can drift slightly towards blue, and small differences in tone and texture make every piece unique. Matt white is somewhat more sensitive to scratches. The colours here are just the beginning: with a test firing we get close to the shade you want.

intro.text: In souvenirs, our strength is above all textiles: T-shirts, hoodies, caps, beanies, bags and socks with motifs for cities and regions. Because we produce ourselves, design ourselves and have a large European network, we react quickly, even for small quantities.

staerken: In our own production facility we decorate quickly and flexibly. Samples and reproductions without long distances.
Partners in Poland, Portugal and Turkey. This lets us find the right manufacturing for every product and every quantity.
New motifs and products are implemented quickly. You can react to trends, seasons and events instead of planning a year ahead.
Test instead of filling the warehouse: we also produce small series and restock when a motif sells.
Our designers and product developers create motifs, collections and products with you or for you.
Textile labelling, care labels, EAN barcodes, hangtags and packaging: your goods arrive the way retail and the law require.
ablauf: You bring a theme, a city or a trend. Or we suggest motifs.
